children: Technology One is viewed at Morgan Stanley as one of the best examples of an Australian company using AI to accelerate growth. Analyst Andrew McLeod tells clients in a note that the enterprise software provider is successfully using AI to accelerate new product development, win new customers and drive higher revenue per customer. McLeod, who already has an overweight rating on the stock, thinks both customer lifetime value and shareholder value could rise further if Technology One can keep churn rates low while growth accelerates. MS lifts its target price on the stock by 25% to 40.00 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.2% at A$32.86. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
